pr_title: planner: enforce the required property when hint cannot satisfy it
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #15571, close #16017 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary: 
This PR fixes some cases that the optimizer hint is not applied even if it is applicable.
Here are some examples:
```
mysql> desc t;
+-------+---------+------+------+---------+-------+
| Field | Type    | Null | Key  | Default | Extra |
+-------+---------+------+------+---------+-------+
| a     | int(11) | NO   | PRI  | NULL    |       |
| b     | int(11) | YES  | MUL  | NULL    |       |
+-------+---------+------+------+---------+-------+
2 rows in set (0.00 sec)
```

```
mysql> desc select /*+ INL_JOIN(t2) */ * from t t1, t t2 where t1.a = t2.b order by t2.a ;
+------------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| id                           | estRows  | task      | access object | operator info                                                              |
+------------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| IndexJoin_30                 | 12487.50 | root      |               | inner join, inner:TableReader_29, outer key:hints.t.b, inner key:hints.t.a |
| ├─TableReader_38(Build)      | 9990.00  | root      |               | data:Selection_37                                                          |
| │ └─Selection_37             | 9990.00  | cop[tikv] |               | not(isnull(hints.t.b))                                                     |
| │   └─TableFullScan_36       | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t2      | keep order:true, stats:pseudo                                              |
| └─TableReader_29(Probe)      | 1.00     | root      |               | data:TableRangeScan_28                                                     |
|   └─TableRangeScan_28        | 1.00     | cop[tikv] | table:t1      | range: decided by [hints.t.b], keep order:false, stats:pseudo              |
+------------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
6 rows in set, 1 warning (0.00 sec)

mysql> desc select /*+ INL_HASH_JOIN(t2) */ * from t t1, t t2 where t1.a = t2.b order by t2.a ;
+------------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| id                           | estRows  | task      | access object | operator info                                                              |
+------------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| IndexJoin_30                 | 12487.50 | root      |               | inner join, inner:TableReader_29, outer key:hints.t.b, inner key:hints.t.a |
| ├─TableReader_38(Build)      | 9990.00  | root      |               | data:Selection_37                                                          |
| │ └─Selection_37             | 9990.00  | cop[tikv] |               | not(isnull(hints.t.b))                                                     |
| │   └─TableFullScan_36       | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t2      | keep order:true, stats:pseudo                                              |
| └─TableReader_29(Probe)      | 1.00     | root      |               | data:TableRangeScan_28                                                     |
|   └─TableRangeScan_28        | 1.00     | cop[tikv] | table:t1      | range: decided by [hints.t.b], keep order:false, stats:pseudo              |
+------------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
6 rows in set, 1 warning (0.00 sec)
```

The two queries above are the same but with different join hint. But the hints don't work. 
The root cause is that optimizer has two branches for the query above: `PhysicalSort -> IndexJoin(t2 is inner)` and `NominalSort -> IndexJoin(t1 is inner)`. The second branch cannot make the hint work, because **the hint does not match the required property** `order by t2.a`. 
In the end, the second branch has a lower cost, so the optimizer choose it.

More examples:
```
mysql> desc select /*+inl_merge_join(t2)*/ t1.a, t2.a from t t1, t t2 ,t t3 where t1.a = t2.a and t3.a=t2.a;
+-----------------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+-----------------------------------------------------+
| id                                | estRows  | task      | access object | operator info                                       |
+-----------------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+-----------------------------------------------------+
| Projection_9                      | 15625.00 | root      |               | hints.t.a, hints.t.a                                |
| └─MergeJoin_10                    | 15625.00 | root      |               | inner join, left key:hints.t.a, right key:hints.t.a |
|   ├─MergeJoin_24(Build)           | 12500.00 | root      |               | inner join, left key:hints.t.a, right key:hints.t.a |
|   │ ├─TableReader_37(Build)       | 10000.00 | root      |               | data:TableFullScan_36                               |
|   │ │ └─TableFullScan_36          | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t2      | keep order:true, stats:pseudo                       |
|   │ └─TableReader_35(Probe)       | 10000.00 | root      |               | data:TableFullScan_34                               |
|   │   └─TableFullScan_34          | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t1      | keep order:true, stats:pseudo                       |
|   └─TableReader_23(Probe)         | 10000.00 | root      |               | data:TableFullScan_22                               |
|     └─TableFullScan_22            | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t3      | keep order:true, stats:pseudo                       |
+-----------------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+-----------------------------------------------------+
9 rows in set, 1 warning (0.00 sec)

mysql> desc select * from t t1, (select /*+ HASH_AGG() */ b, max(a) from t t2 group by b) t2 where t1.b = t2.b order by t1.b;
+----------------------------------+---------+-----------+----------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| id                               | estRows | task      | access object        | operator info                                                                           |
+----------------------------------+---------+-----------+----------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Projection_46                    | 9990.00 | root      |                      | hints.t.a, hints.t.b, hints.t.b, Column#5                                               |
| └─MergeJoin_47                   | 9990.00 | root      |                      | inner join, left key:hints.t.b, right key:hints.t.b                                     |
|   ├─StreamAgg_32(Build)          | 7992.00 | root      |                      | group by:hints.t.b, funcs:max(Column#6)->Column#5, funcs:firstrow(hints.t.b)->hints.t.b |
|   │ └─IndexReader_33             | 7992.00 | root      |                      | index:StreamAgg_29                                                                      |
|   │   └─StreamAgg_29             | 7992.00 | cop[tikv] |                      | group by:hints.t.b, funcs:max(hints.t.a)->Column#6                                      |
|   │     └─IndexFullScan_31       | 9990.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t2, index:b(b) | keep order:true, stats:pseudo                                                           |
|   └─IndexReader_28(Probe)        | 9990.00 | root      |                      | index:IndexFullScan_27                                                                  |
|     └─IndexFullScan_27           | 9990.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t1, index:b(b) | keep order:true, stats:pseudo                                                           |
+----------------------------------+---------+-----------+----------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
8 rows in set (0.00 sec)
```
### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed:

change the method `exhaustPhysicalPlans(prop *property.PhysicalProperty) []PhysicalPlan` to `exhaustPhysicalPlans(prop *property.PhysicalProperty) ([]PhysicalPlan, bool)`.
The second returned values means: if there is a hint that cannot match the property. If so, we should enforce the property and try the hint again.

How it Works:

To solve this problem, we should make hint work whatever the required property is. We can
enforce the property when the hint cannot match it.

- Need to cherry-pick to the release branch 4.0(maybe 3.1 is also required)

    - Consumes more CPU
